Name: Syanide's Animal Expanion
Author: Syanide23
Description:
Animal Expansion adds several farm animals and items that serve to expand vanilla items and animals. Various preexisting items now have animals that expand on them. For example, calico eggs, an item that exists in vanilla, can be incubated and produces an animal. Each animal and added item is designed to be realistic and lore-friendly, with my own personal flair. However, if something doesn't suit your fancy, each animal can be disabled in the config. Several of the animals have vanilla-style sprites alongside sprites that fit my own design, which can be toggled between. This is because I plan to release my own sprites for the vanilla farm animals, and so they exist for cohesion. Each animal is designed to be implemented in a way that they can be found through regular game play. Don't be afraid to see if a vanilla item might now produce an animal if incubated!

Extra Animal Configs is required for several of the animals to function properly.


Requirements and how to obtain each animal can be found in the articles tab for brevity and to avoid spoilers for those wishing. I will also be explaining why and where I got the idea for each, because I want to in another article :)

﻿Some animals I thought about adding, such as the Pepper Rex or Roosters, but there are several mods for each, so I focused on those without first, but suggestions for expansion are welcome!

[b]
Compatibility:[/b]
This mod isn't compatible with any mod that changes certain items. One that I know off the top of my head is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25051]Eggs Mayo and Cheese Expansion[/url]. It also isn't compatible with my older mods that have been updated to 1.6, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22204]Syanide23's Fruit Bats for 1.6[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22121]Syanide23's Owls for 1.6[/url] or my newer [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29933]Gem Birds for Barn[/url], as they have been absorbed into this one. What you can do is either delete those mods or simply disable the same animals in this one. Other than those, I cannot think of any other issues, but feel free to let me know.
